title: Coherence of finite coproducts of a coherent ideal
statement: Let Z be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], I an ideal sheaf whose module is coherent [pqf-def-coherent], and r ≥ 0. The coproduct of r copies of I.toModules is coherent [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

proof.text: The locally Noetherian criterion makes I.toModules quasi-coherent and of finite type. Arbitrary coproduct closure gives quasi-coherence for the coproduct indexed by ULift (Fin r); Sigma.reindex Equiv.ulift transports it to the Fin r coproduct.

Choose finite local generating data q for I. On each q.X i, GeneratingSections.sigma combines r copies of the finite generating family. The union has index type the finite sum of finite types, hence is finite. Transfer this family along preservation of coproducts by overFunctor and the reindexing isomorphism. This gives finite local generators for the Fin r coproduct, including the empty family for r = 0.
Apply the locally Noetherian criterion to the resulting quasi-coherent finite-type coproduct.
